row.title: CODEAGENT-MODEL-1: the code agent's first model is glm-4.7-flash
row.body: The platform deprecated @cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash on 2026-11-20 (error 5028); 35 of 95 code agent calls that day went to it and produced nothing. The first adapter in seed/worker/src/codeagent.js, dashboard/agent.js, doctrine/code-agents.json and the review gate reference is now @cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash, probed live the same day with reasoning_effort low (it returned the requested JSON). The adapter id workers-ai-glm is unchanged so history joins.
